changelog: 1.0.51.29 - Define Exp_RipSource. Includes_Object.xml uses $EXP[Exp_RipSource] on the rip source badge but upstream never defines the expression (confirmed in clean 1.0.52), so every Home and video view load logged 'Misplaced ]' + 'Error parsing boolean expression [!skin.hassetting(textcodecs)] + []' (seen on Asaf's Shield, 2026-09-17) and the badge could never appear. Defined as a pure boolean from the exact conditions Image_RipSource resolves on (its filename tokens, or a non-empty FallbackSourceFlag), in the style of the skin's own expressions -- deliberately NOT String.IsEmpty($VAR[...]), which no skin we ship uses.
